fields.name: account_holder
fields.hint: the name on the statement, verbatim

fields.name: institution
fields.hint: the bank or brokerage that issued the statement

fields.name: account_type
fields.hint: the account type stated on the statement

fields.name: period_start
fields.hint: the statement period's first date, YYYY-MM-DD

fields.name: period_end
fields.hint: the statement period's last date, YYYY-MM-DD

fields.name: beginning_balance
fields.hint: the stated beginning balance, no currency symbol

fields.name: ending_balance
fields.hint: the stated ending balance, no currency symbol

fields.name: largest_deposit_amount
fields.hint: the dollar amount of the single largest deposit line this period, or null if no deposits posted

fields.name: largest_deposit_description
fields.hint: that deposit's description, copied verbatim, or null if no deposits posted

fields.name: deposit_documented
fields.hint: does that deposit's description name a specific, verifiable INSTITUTIONAL counterparty (a named employer, IRS, a named pension fund, SSA, or a named bank/brokerage on a transfer)? A personal P2P transfer, cash deposit, or generic description is 'no' even if it uses the word payroll or direct deposit with no employer named. null if no deposits posted.
